items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: What are you going to do about Blind Boone and Scott Joplin? ... Blind Boone did not read any music, but he had a teacher when he was a little boy. ... Blind Boone played the piano so skillfully.

ctx.x: What are you going to do about Blind Boone and Scott Joplin? What are you going to do about it? Now, Blind Boone did not read any music, but he had a teacher when he was a little boy. He did have his sight and he read Blind before he- He came from Missouri somewhere.
That's right. My mother always talked about him when she was a girl.
